sonicScene.thesis: Bubble Reef: a lost 8-bit water level grown into 3D and swum through for ever -- three areas with their own palettes round a deep basin -- that plays along with the music: the bass bends the kelp, a melody rings a row of bell flowers, a chord blooms the coral, drums burst bubbles and flash the treasure, and a big friendly fish circling over the lane swims the melody.

composition.background: the giant coral tower across the basin, rock walls and kelp silhouettes in blue depth
composition.midground: the level: arches, columns, pipes, giant flowers, coral, coins along the lane
composition.foreground: kelp, rocks and bubbles sliding past the lens
composition.focal: the next arch or the next landmark ahead on the lane
secondary: the guide (a big friendly voxel fish circling over the lane)
composition.atmosphere: blue depth haze in each area's own water colour; light shafts; bubbles
composition.camera: a playful swim along the ring, bobbing and swaying

palette.saturation: saturated game colours, three palettes, hard toon bands

very_slow: the lap through the three areas

vocabulary: every kelp plant bends at once; the brain coral pulses; the sunlight swells
the coins and gems flash; a ring ripples out through the water
a swarm of bubbles bursts round you; the fish schools turn and dart
the fish swim faster; the bubble streams thicken
STRUCTURE: the coral grows as the piece builds
a row of twelve bell flowers in each area, one per pitch class: a melody rings them note by note
a chord blooms every brain coral and lights it
how big the bubble burst a note releases is
the kelp glows while notes are held
STRUCTURE: the depth -- the water darkens and thickens
THE GUIDE, a big friendly voxel fish circling over the lane, swims the melody's contour (higher notes lift it); a kick bobs it, the bass beats its tail
the swim goes on; the level idles, swaying
sonicScene.tier: light: voxel meshes and low-segment primitives, toon light, analytic fog, a few hundred bubbles
sonicScene.title: 8-Bit Ocean
